programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - Shaking Up Soul Food'. Kardea takes on the challenge of making vegan soul food. She makes dishes like lemon-pepper fried 'chicken' tenders and vegan baked mac and cheese.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: 'S6/E12 - Mosquito Beach Dinner'. Kardea hosts a dinner to celebrate a significant place in Charleston's Gullah history. West African peanut stew and stuffed whole snapper are on the menu.

programme.title: Dessert Games
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Sugar High'. Duff Goldman has more tough challenges in store for the pastry chefs. But Guy Fieri makes them even tougher with his endless pranks - including some bizarre ingredients!

programme.title: Armando's Asian Twist
programme.desc: 'S1/E11 - Super Saver Student Special'. After arriving on campus and seeing an empty fridge, Armando prepares a budget-friendly birthday feast for students at a local college.

programme.title: Armando's Asian Twist
programme.desc: 'S1/E12 - Aboriginal Awesomeness'. Armando spends time with Taiwan's Amis tribe, who show how they raise water buffalo. Next, he uses daylilies to put a twist on a classic risotto dish.

programme.title: The Great Food Truck Race
programme.desc: 'S19/E3 - Sweet & Savory: Knoxville Pt 1'. In Knoxville, TN, six teams sell to game day crowds at the University of Tennessee before serving a more refined crowd at the Rossini Opera Festival.

programme.title: The Great Food Truck Race
programme.desc: 'S19/E4 - Sweet & Savory: Knoxville Pt 2'. The teams embrace the theme at a whimsical fantasy village in Knoxville, TN, and tackle an 'enchanted dish' taste challenge.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E8 - From North To South America'. From a Houston joint's Argentinian empanadas to street tacos in Cancun, Mexico, Guy Fieri digs into flavours spanning the Americas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E9 - Goin' International'. Guy Fieri grabs gangster global grub such as oxtail and curry goat from a Jamaican joint in Houston, and a 24-hour burrito hot spot in Cancun, Mexico.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E10 - Wonder Women'. Guy Fieri visits all-female line-ups in Houston and Orlando. A grandma serves up family recipes like homemade tamales, and he checks out a funky meatball spot.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E11 - Multicultural Cooking'. Guy Fieri digs into the gastronomic traditions of different cultures including a Mexican joint in Houston and a Jewish deli-on-wheels in Orlando, Florida.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E12 - Turkey, Taters And Dogs'. Guy digs into a mashup of flavours, including a potato-centric palace dishing out hearty Brazilian specialties and a deli serving latkes and turkey pastrami.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E13 - Burgers, Beef And Barbecue'. Guy Fieri samples beef and barbecue in Florida and California, including a Vietnamese spot serving up tasty pho and a BBQ joint making a twist on lasagne.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E14 - Chicken Trifecta'. Guy Fieri hits the road for top chicken dinners. In Hawaii visits Mick Fleetwood's restaurant and he checks out a California hot dog spot's chicken and waffles.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E15 - From Spicy To Icy'. Guy Fieri heats up with spice and cools off with ice! He visits a hot BBQ joint in California, a Cajun spot in Virginia and a Hawaiian place's tropical shaved ice.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E16 - Island And Desert'. Guy Fieri hunts desert and island flavour. He enjoys nostalgic breakfast tarts at a café in California and fish and chips at a gluten-free spot in Hawaii.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S27/E1 - Sandwiches, Spaetzle And Wings'. In Virginia, Guy Fieri finds a spot serving sandwiches by day and sticky wings at night. In Hawaii, a German-Swiss joint dishes up apple strudel.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S27/E2 - Flavor Adventure'. Guy Fieri takes a culinary trip with adventurous flavour. A funky LA spot fills bowls with eclectic eats while a Norfolk, VA, market offers Mexican specialties.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S29/E6 - Grocery Game Plan'. The hosts each pick one supermarket staple to use in an easy and delicious weeknight dish, proving that even the professionals use shortcuts!

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S6/E1 - Bakin' With Bacon'. 12 young bakers are competing to impress the judges with their bacon cupcakes. They must use their assigned ingredient in a creative way for a chance to win.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Selena + CUT Steakhouse'. At Wolfgang Puck's gorgeous CUT steakhouse, Selena Gomez takes on two initiation tests before creating her own spicy seafood dish.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Selena + Lemon Grove'. At Chef Marcel Vigneron's Lemon Grove, Selena Gomez creates a colourful dish with unusual ingredients. Will Marcel make the dish his new special?

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Selena + Girl & The Goat'. Selena Gomez steps up her game in Stephanie Izard's kitchen. For her special, Selena makes a ricotta toast inspired by cheese and crackers.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Selena + Ms Chi'. Selena Gomez and Shirley Chung create a fusion version of a childhood favourite. Later, Selena tries to make a dish good enough for the Ms Chi's menu.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Selena + Alta Adams'. Selena Gomez feels the pressure at Alta, Keith Corbin's California restaurant. Later, she makes a fried fish dish for Atla's toughest critic.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Selena + Moo's Craft Barbecue'. Selena Gomez tries the best Texas BBQ in Los Angeles at Moo's Craft Barbecue. Then, Selena puts her own spin on their meat-centric menu.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods With Andrew Zimmern
programme.desc: 'S5/E1 - Mexico City: Corn Smut & Ants'. Andrew Zimmern is in Mexico City to learn about the area's local cuisine. He tucks into stewed pig knuckles, worms and ant eggs!

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Feasts Over Fire In Hawaii'. Roger's first visit to Hawaii promises big fires and big feasts. On Nimitz Highway in Honolulu, is family-run restaurant Koala Moa, famous for whole chickens roasted over a fire.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Smoke And Steam'. Hawaii island Oahu, is known as the 'gathering place' and Roger is invited to two community gatherings abundant with local foods.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E4 - Takeout: All Kinds Of Flavor'. Guy Fieri cooks takeout with four chefs via video chat. He makes American Indian fare from Denver and short ribs all the way from Hawaii.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E5 - South Dakota Smorgasbord'. Guy is in South Dakota to visit the state's first Ethiopian joint, And, he checks out the unique comfort food at a Midwest-Southern restaurant.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E6 - Spicin' Things Up'. In South Dakota, Guy visits a gourmet sandwich joint that's making delicious fusion food. And, he checks out a quirky pizza restaurant in Alaska.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S1/E11 - Zurich'. Andrew goes to Zurich, the origin of some of Switzerland's most indulgent comfort foods, from warm gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate made with a modern twist.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S1/E12 - Hong Kong'. Hong Kong's seven million residents flock to its many restaurants and noodle houses daily. Andrew finds out just what makes this destination so delicious.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E11 - Managua'. Andrew reveals the must-try foods of Nicaragua's capital Managua. He tries a steamed beef dish called baho to the crispy pork skin-topped salad known as vigaron.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E12 - Santiago'. Andrew reveals the flavours of the culinary paradise of Santiago, Chile. He tries some of Santiago's signature dishes such as asado a la parrilla and pastel de jaiba.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Catch Me If You Can'. The remaining six chefs wade into the lagoon to secure their protein. In a fiery Gauntlet showdown, the bottom two chefs face a prickly crustacean.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S56/E10 - Make No 'Misteak''. A trendy pastry in the first round inspires debate among the chefs. Plus, the chefs must figure out combine comfort food with a savoury frozen item.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E13 - Sunny's Ringers'. Sunny Anderson and Amanda Freitag enlist the help of chefs Ed Oliveira and Eric McCree to conquer Bobby Flay's kitchen.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E14 - Style And Sass'. Fashion icon Carson Kressley and Chef Stephanie Boswell 'zhuzh up' chefs Chris Infinger and Kevin Lee and prepare them for victory over Bobby Flay.

programme.title: Bobby Flay's The Line
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Fabio Viviani: Giostra'. There's a lot on the line for Antonia Lofaso when her friend and fellow Italian Fabio Viviani challenges Bobby Flay's home team to a battle Italiano.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: 'S1/E9 - Heat Day'. The returning winner defends their title against Franklin Becker and Allison Fasano as they ignite the judges' taste buds with their spiciest dishes.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: 'S15/E9 - Nap Time Meal Done Right!'. Molly Yeh makes a delicious dinner during naptime. She whips up a spin on a popular soup, simple salmon, a rolled omelette and a lightly sweet snack.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S4/E2 - Blooming Delicious'. The nine remaining bakers must create cupcake flower arrangements and amp with flower essences. And, they make and decorate mirror-glazed gazing balls in edible gardens.

programme.title: Holiday Wars
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Reindeer Auditions'. In the first qualifying round, the three teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase an unlikely understudy who dreams of pulling Santa's sleigh.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E11 - Triple D Nation: Tots & Turkey'. Guy Fieri loads up on over-the-top turkey legs in Tennessee before hitting up unbelievable blueberry pierogies and top-notch tots in New York.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E12 - Triple D Nation: American Eats'. Guy Fieri checks in on some amped-up American eats, like funky fritters in Phoenix, mind-blowing pancakes in New York and snapper soup in Indiana.

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing
programme.desc: 'S3/E9 - Shift 8: Elevation, Part 2'. The final three chefs must elevate the weeknight family meal and cook a Michelin-worthy dish to win the competition and the grand prize of $100,000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: 'S17/E1 - Fixing A Family In Houston'. Robert is in Texas to help a restaurant that's on the verge of closing. The overcontrolling owner risks losing both his business and his family.
